text: Mariam is coeliac, properly strict, not just avoiding bread. Book somewhere with a separate gluten free menu for Friday.
Antoine's daughter starts reception next Tuesday. He's more nervous than she is lol
esther - oat milk flat white, no sugar. hates anything with coconut

Just off the phone with Olivia. Her son Kai graduates from Leeds on 2 November 2026, they're driving up the night before and staying two nights. She's so proud she nearly cried telling me. Need to send a card to Kai before then, maybe with a bit of cash in it.
Grace has gone vegan since September. Still drinks proper espresso though.
anil obsessed w/ chess again, plays online every night, rated about 1600 now apparently
Luca and Ellie are hosting a wine tasting thing this weekend, I'm bringing cheese.
Esme's driving test is tomorrow at 9. Text her good luck tonight.
Oliver supports Spurs, season ticket holder for 20 years. Never mention Arsenal.
Zainab mentioned her little one Yusuf lost his first tooth yesterday and the tooth fairy left a fiver. Inflation!
Chris said Lukas got into the under 12s county squad. Big deal for him, trials were in the summer.
Pick up dry cleaning Thursday, dentist next Monday at 4.

Jess knits. Like seriously knits, she's doing a whole Fair Isle jumper for her dad's 70th in March 2027. She showed me the pattern, it's got about six colours and she's already unpicked the yoke twice. Also learning to spin her own yarn on a wheel she found on Marketplace. Wool shop voucher would be perfect for her birthday.
Irina's allergic to tree nuts, carries an EpiPen. Remember for the Christmas do.
juan and hana's wedding anniversary is the 14th, they're going to that tapas place they had their first date at

Shanice said her mum's struggling after the hip op last week. Shanice is doing all the shopping and driving over every evening. She sounded exhausted, said she hasn't been to choir in three weeks and her own back's playing up from all the lifting. Her mum's not allowed to drive until mid December. I should drop round with a lasagne on Sunday and see how they're both holding up, and maybe offer to do a Tuesday run.
Victor collects vinyl, mostly 70s soul and funk. Has about 2000 records. His wife Agnieszka says the spare room is now a record room.
Wei's GCSE mocks start in a fortnight. Her parents are stressing more than she is honestly.
Alana keeps dropping hints about the new Zelda game. Birthday is 3rd December.
Karim's doing Dry January early, so no wine at the dinner on the 8th. Get some of that alcohol free gin he likes.
Abebe ran the Royal Parks half on Sunday, 1:52, a PB. Message him congrats.
Archie, or Arch as everyone calls him, is starting a pottery course next Wednesday evenings. Ask how the first class goes.
Thabo is a massive rugby fan, Springboks obviously. World Cup chat for hours. Also doesn't eat pork.

So Dong's barbecue on Saturday is cancelled because of the forecast, moved indoors to a curry night at his instead. Still on for 7. He said his wife Hana's making her lamb biryani and to not eat lunch. Their kids are doing a poster for the table apparently. I'm bringing mango lassi and those pistachio things from the Turkish bakery, Dong can't get enough of them.
Dalia's twins finish primary next July and they've got their 11 plus in September 2027. She's already looking at tutors.
Jamal told me his dog Biscuit needs a tooth out on Friday, he's worried about the anaesthetic since Biscuit's 13.
Mariam Khan from the book club picks the next book, she loves Japanese fiction, think Murakami and Kawakami.
Remind me to ask Antoine how the parents evening went on Thursday, he was dreading it.
esther n her husband off to Lisbon fri for long wknd, back tues. she wants pastel de nata recs
Graduation dinner for Olivia's niece Ellie got called off, Ellie's dad is ill. Olivia's going to visit him at the hospital tomorrow.
Grace's son Oliver had his first swimming badge this morning, 10 metres no float. She sent a video.
Anil's brother Karim is visiting from Toronto in a fortnight, staying three weeks. Anil wants to take him to a Leicester game.
luca hates mushrooms. like hates hates. pick something else for the risotto
Note to self: book eye test, renew passport before March 2027, sort car insurance by next Friday.

Kai's in the school play next Thursday, he's playing the Tin Man. Super nervous about his song. Olivia says he's practising in the bath every night and made his little sister sit through it four times on Sunday. She's asked if I can come along, tickets are a fiver at the door, starts at 6. Remind me to text Kai a break a leg on Thursday morning.
Esme's into bouldering now, goes three times a week at the wall in town. Wants climbing shoes for Christmas, size 6.

Talked to Zainab after work. Her eldest, Amira, got her A level results in August and is starting medicine at Bristol on 21 September. Zainab's thrilled but already dreading the empty bedroom. Her husband's been quiet about it. Must send Amira something for her first week, maybe a nice hamper, and check in with Zainab around the end of September once she's actually gone.
Chris and his partner Lukas are doing Veganuary together. Chris says the cheese is the hardest bit.
Jess's daughter is taking her grade 5 piano exam on Saturday. Jess says she's barely sleeping over it.
Irina loves Russian crime novels, reading her way through all of Akunin. Has the Fandorin series in hardback.
Did Juan's interview on Monday go ok? He hasn't said. Don't forget to message him.
Hana is pregnant!! Due in April. Off sushi and soft cheese obviously, she's gutted about the brie.
Shanice's brother Jamal has his graduation ceremony on Wednesday 4 November 2026, Masters in architecture. Whole family going.
Victor's gone keto. No bread, no potatoes, no beer. Lots of steak.
wei plays bass in a jazz band, gig at the Crown next sat, we're all going
Alana's grandad passed away last week, funeral is next Tuesday. Call her this weekend, see how she's doing.
Need to make the shopping list, Sunday lunch for 8, and remember the gravy granules this time.
Karim said his daughter Leila took her first steps on Tuesday. He's thrilled, only 10 months old.

Abebe's into board games, big Catan and Wingspan person, hosts a games night every other Friday. Only drinks Ethiopian coffee, brings his own beans and a little hand grinder everywhere, even on holiday. Next one is Friday the 30th, he's invited me and said bring someone who likes long games. Maybe ask Jess, she'd love it.
Archie's mum is turning 80 on 12 March 2027, he's organising a surprise party at the cricket club. I'm doing the cake.
Agnieszka's son Tomek starts secondary in September, she's nervous about the bus journey.

Thabo and his wife Naledi just moved into the new place on Elm Road. Housewarming next Saturday, I said I'd bring wine, red not white, Naledi can't drink white. Thabo's spent every evening this week putting up shelves and he's already put a drill through a pipe once. Their cat Juju keeps hiding under the bath.
Dong told me he's training for a sprint triathlon in May 2027, first one ever. Swimming is the weak spot.
Dalia hates coriander, says it tastes like soap. Loves anything with lemon though.
Quick one: Jamal's sister Grace finished her nursing degree, graduates in December. He wants to chip in for something nice, I said count me in.
Mariam's son Ali starts nursery Monday, she's back at work full time the same day. Check in with her Tuesday evening, it'll be a lot.
antoine does sourdough. has a starter called Gerald. very serious about it
Esther's grandson Luca was born on Saturday, 8lb 2oz. Everyone doing well. Must get a card and a little outfit before we see them next weekend.

Ran through the week with Olivia: her mocks prep for Kai on Monday, swimming Wednesday, her own book club Thursday, and Saturday morning she's at the farmers market selling her chutneys. Then her brother Victor and his kids come for Sunday roast. Busy woman. Kai's mocks are actually the week of 9 November, she wants him to do two hours a night until then. Honestly she needs a break more than he does.
Back from the gym, legs dead. Tomorrow rest day then long run Sunday.
